# Trust Administration Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Wealth Management

## Overview

Use when managing trust administration operations including trust accounting, beneficiary distributions, tax reporting (Form 1041), fiduciary duty compliance, and trust document interpretation for wealth management trust departments.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [trust-administration-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
trust-administration-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@trust-administration` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Maintain trust accounting with income and principal allocation per trust terms
- Process discretionary and mandatory distributions to beneficiaries
- Prepare Form 1041 income tax return with beneficiary K-1 allocations
- Apply Principal and Income Act rules for receipt and expense allocation

## Industry Standards Applied

- **Uniform Trust Code**: Model trust administration law adopted by most states
- **Uniform Prudent Investor Act**: Fiduciary standard for trust investment management
- **Uniform Principal and Income Act**: Allocation rules for trust receipts and expenses
